extOpenchannel.endpoint.enabledFailed: The endpoint may not have changed. Check the state above before trying again.
extOpenchannel.endpoint.noGrant: You have not been granted access to this connector's endpoint.
extOpenchannel.endpoint.openFailed: The endpoint may not have been opened. Check the state above before trying again.
extOpenchannel.endpoint.sub: Your own address on this installation. Nobody else can open, read or re-point it, and opening it twice gives you the same one.
extOpenchannel.endpoint.title: Your endpoint
extOpenchannel.error.capture_not_declare: This installation does not admit this connector's capture. Nothing on this screen will fix it — report it to whoever runs this installation.
extOpenchannel.error.capture_unavailable: The CRM's capture pipeline could not be reached. Nothing was lost and the next pass tries again.
extOpenchannel.error.delivery_refused: Your registered address answered and declined the message.
extOpenchannel.error.delivery_unanswered: The message left and no answer ever came back. It is not sent again, because a repeat could deliver it twice.
extOpenchannel.error.delivery_undelivera: Nothing was sent: this endpoint has no usable address. Register an https address, mint a signing secret, and leave the endpoint accepting.
extOpenchannel.error.member_not_permitte: Your access changed, so this request could not be captured. Ask an administrator what you may capture.
extOpenchannel.error.payload_unusable: The sending system posted a shape this connector does not accept. Whoever runs that sender has to correct what it posts.
extOpenchannel.error.refused_by_the_core: The CRM refused this message as invalid, so no timeline entry was created. Posting it unchanged cannot help.
extOpenchannel.inbound.empty: Nothing has arrived on your endpoint yet.
extOpenchannel.inbound.noGrant: You have not been granted access to what arrives here.
extOpenchannel.inbound.sub: The most recent requests that arrived, newest first. The payloads are deliberately not shown — only their size — because they are bytes a remote party chose.
extOpenchannel.inbound.title: What arrived
extOpenchannel.outbound.registerFailed: The address may not have been registered. Check the field above before trying again.
extOpenchannel.outbound.urlHint: It must be https and name a host, and it may not carry credentials — those would ride every request. Registering it sends nothing by itself.
extOpenchannel.outbound.urlLabel: Where this connector talks back to
extOpenchannel.outboundList.empty: Nothing has been sent from your endpoint yet.
extOpenchannel.outboundList.noGrant: You have not been granted access to what leaves here.
extOpenchannel.outboundList.sub: The most recent messages this connector posted to your registered address, newest first. The bodies are on the CRM records they were sent from.
extOpenchannel.outboundList.title: What left
extOpenchannel.outboundList.why: Why it did not go through
extOpenchannel.recipe.demoBody: A message posted from outside, to prove the endpoint verifies.
extOpenchannel.recipe.signedOver: The signature is the HMAC-SHA256 of {material}, hex-encoded, under the signing secret. Send it as sha256=<hex>. The timestamp is unix seconds and must be recent; the nonce may be used once.
extOpenchannel.recipe.sub: Point a sender at the address below and sign what it posts. Every request that carries no valid signature is refused, whoever sent it.
extOpenchannel.recipe.title: Sending to your endpoint
extOpenchannel.recipe.urlNotSecret: This address is not a credential. It appears in access logs and in every proxy between a sender and this installation, exactly as any other path does — share it with whoever configures the sender. Only the signing secret admits a request.
extOpenchannel.secret.mintFailed: No new secret was shown, so the previous one may still be the one that verifies. Try again before reconfiguring any sender.
extOpenchannel.secret.shownOnce: This is the only time this secret is shown. Nothing reads it back — copy it into the sender now, or mint another one, which stops this one verifying.
extOpenchannel.sub: A signed POST from a system with no account here lands on the CRM timeline, and what the CRM sends back is signed the same way.
extOpenchannel.title: Open channel
